lines.cap: Your phone wakes up at night when you're asleep. And it reports to the room.
lines.say: Your phone wakes up at night when you're asleep. And it reports to the room.

lines.cap: Three AM. Screen off. But somewhere inside, apps are still running. Refreshing. Checking. Sending.
lines.say: Three AM. Screen off. But somewhere inside, apps are still running. Refreshing. Checking. Sending.

lines.cap: On the wall, little lights blink. Each one is a phone. Each one is a person. Asleep. Reporting.
lines.say: On the wall, little lights blink. Each one is a phone. Each one is a person. Asleep. Reporting.

lines.cap: What do they send? Where you are. What you did today. How long you slept.
lines.say: What do they send? Where you are. What you did today. How long you slept.

lines.cap: At the end, how to make your phone actually sleep.
lines.say: At the end, how to make your phone actually sleep.

lines.cap: One phone reported its owner talks in his sleep. He just says pizza. The room ordered some.
lines.say: One phone reported its owner talks in his sleep. He just says pizza. The room ordered some.

lines.cap: Real tip. Turn off background app refresh for apps that don't need it. On iPhone, settings, general, background app refresh. On Android, restrict background data.
lines.say: Real tip. Turn off background app refresh for apps that don't need it. On iPhone, settings, general, background app refresh. On Android, restrict background data.
